what: Planned cap logic copies session-env-first precedence but review dispatch uses process-env-first
scenario_or_breakage: `step-5-review.sh` is specified to copy `step-5-entry.sh` cap resolution (session-env awk, then process `LARCH_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_MAX`, then default `3`), while `review-and-fix step5` resolves the cap in `_dynamic_archetypes` with process env before session-env (`python/review_and_fix.py:1497-1499`). When those sources disagree the banner can show cap N while the review loop runs (or stalls on) cap M; e.g. session-env `2` plus process `9` yields banner `cap=2` then `STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS=stall` from dispatch
suggested_fix: In `step-5-review.sh`, mirror `_dynamic_archetypes` precedence (process env, then session-env, then default `3`) or call a shared resolver; do not copy session-first `step-5-entry.sh` order if the banner must match dispatch
